name: alphaXiv
description: Fast retrieval (both keyword and embedding search) tools across the millions of papers in the arXiv corpus. Give your agent context on the latest research papers.

_published_faq.name: How do I add alphaXiv to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add alphaXiv to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.alphaxiv.org/mcp/v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the alphaXiv MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: alphaXiv provides these MCP tools: answer_pdf_queries, get_paper_content, read_files_from_github, embedding_similarity_search, full_text_papers_search, and agentic_paper_retrieval.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to alphaXiv?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to alphaXiv in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.
alphaXiv requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
alphaXiv is developed by alphaXiv. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
